title.en: AI Scientist v2 — Workshop-Level Autonomous Research

hook: Sakana's AI Scientist v2 (Yamada et al., arXiv:2504.08066) runs the full research loop: hypothesis, code, experiments, figures, writeup, submission. It is the first system to have a generated paper pass peer review at an ICLR 2025 workshop. Independent evaluation (Beel et al.) found 42% of experiments failed from coding errors and literature review frequently mislabeled established concepts as novel. Sakana's own docs warn that the codebase executes LLM-written code and recommend Docker isolation. Both halves of that picture are the point.
